run_entity_linking_pipeline: run the end-to-end entity linking pipeline on an input text file using NER, candidate generation, and reranking
run_ner_mention_detection: run named entity recognition to detect and extract entity mentions from input sentences
run_solr_candidate_generation: run candidate entity generation by querying a Solr index for each detected mention
run_candidate_reranking: run BERT-based reranking to score and rank candidate entities for each mention
run_entity_linking_with_datafetcher: run entity linking with additional knowledge base data fetched for each candidate entity
